It remains the tallest completed building as of 2026.
 
It stands nearly 500 feet taller than the second-place building, Merdeka 118.

Note: Jeddah Tower is planned to surpass the Burj Khalifa, but it is still under construction, so it does not count yet. 
The list only includes completed buildings.
